Family Table A Seat For Everyone
Our Table

Cooking the way it's always been done

The Long Table started as a Sunday habit — too much food, too many chairs pulled up, nobody leaving hungry. We kept that habit and opened the doors. Every recipe here has been made a hundred times before it ever touched a menu.

House Rule №1

Always cook enough for one more plate.
